The test image shows a mango leaf with:
- Dark black/brown irregular spots scattered across the surface
- Green base color with some yellowing
- Spots appear sooty/dark, not powdery white
- Spots are distributed across the leaf blade

This pattern strongly suggests Sooty Mould (dark, sooty deposits) or Anthracnose (dark irregular lesions). Let me check a Sooty Mould reference.

The Sooty Mould reference is a strong match: dark sooty/black irregular patches scattered across a green mango leaf surface, identical pattern to the test image. The spots are not well-defined lesions (which would suggest Anthracnose), but rather sooty deposits coating the leaf surface.
